newsitem.title: USA: SigmaTron sees strong momentum for Q2.
newsitem.headline: SigmaTron sees strong momentum for Q2.

text.p: SigmaTron International Inc, reporting record earnings for the fiscal first quarter, said Monday its momentum remains strong for the second quarter.

"The record results are a reflection of the increased demand for SigmaTron's services by both existing and new customers," Gary Fairhead, president, said in a statement. "Our momentum for the second quarter remains strong and we are excited about the opportunities open to us."
He said the company is expanding its Elk Grove Village facility by 9,000 square feet and is examining ways to increase its capacity in Mexico.
"As we continue to diversify our customer base and the markets they serve, we intend to increase the utilization of our resources throughout the year," Fairhead said.
